# P2 — Windows App (WinUI 3 · Windows App SDK · .NET 10 · Fluent)

The native Windows client at full web parity, using **WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK 1.6+**,
**.NET 10 LTS**, C#, and the **Microsoft Fluent** design language. Consumes the **generated
C# client** (ADR-004) — the only platform NOT on KMP — and a C# port of the shared behavior
(units/auth/cache) validated against the P1 golden vectors.

> Prereqs: P1 `S99` DONE (contract + core frozen). Branch `feat/apps-windows` (ADR-007).
> Read ADR-002/004/005/008/010/011 + `apps/docs/*`. Page prompts are GENERATED by P1/S0-0002
> into `p2-windows/pages/` — this index covers the hand-authored scaffolding phases.

## Phases

| Phase | Theme | Prompts | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| **W0** | Project setup | `W0-0001..` | `apps/windows/TeslaSync.sln`, WinUI3 app project, .NET 10 TFM, Native AOT config, CI green |
| **W1** | C# core port | `W1-0001..` | generated C# API client + C# units/auth/cache mirroring P1 (golden vectors pass) |
| **W2** | Design system | `W2-0001..` | `Tokens.xaml` (from `apps/design`), Fluent theme, type ramp, Mica/Acrylic, light/dark |
| **W3** | Component library | `W3-0001..` | native WinUI equivalents of web shared components (GlassPanel→Card+Mica, StatCard, charts wrappers via LiveCharts2/WinUI, MapControl wrapper, EmptyState, Skeleton, DataGrid) |
| **W4** | App shell + navigation | `W4-0001..` | NavigationView shell, routing, window/titlebar, back-stack, deep links, theme switch |
| **W5** | Auth + onboarding | `W5-0001..` | OIDC PKCE via WebAuthenticationBroker, Credential Manager storage, sign-in/onboarding flow |
| **W6** | Live data + push | `W6-0001..` | SSE client, foreground live binding, WNS push registration (ADR-009) |
| **W7** | **Pages (generated)** | `pages/**` (one per manifest page) | every web page at parity, Fluent-native |
| **W8** | Platform polish | `W8-0001..` | jump lists, taskbar, notifications, widgets, window sizing, keyboard/mouse, settings |
| **W9** | Tests | `W9-0001..` | xUnit + WinAppDriver UI tests for each parity unit's states |
| **W99** | Windows acceptance gate | `W99-0001` | parity ledger 100% (windows), all gates green, MSIX packs |

## Binding rules for P2

1. Allowed files scoped to `apps/windows/**` (+ `apps/design/generated/windows/**` for W2).
2. **Fluent-native only**: use WinUI controls + the design tokens. No web pixel-cloning, no
   custom glass hacks where Mica/Acrylic exists (ADR-005). No raw placeholder screens (ADR-011).
3. Every page prompt (W7) is a GENERATED prompt; running it must satisfy its embedded
   `=== PARITY ===` gate (100% of the unit's panels/charts/states/strings) + the placeholder gate.
4. MVVM via CommunityToolkit.Mvvm; data binding to view-models backed by the C# core. No
   business logic in code-behind.

## Exit criteria

- `dotnet build -c Release` + `dotnet format --verify` + analyzers + `dotnet test` all green.
- `apps/parity/windows-ledger.json`: every page-unit `status=done`, `covered==required`.
- C# golden-vector tests (units) pass identically to KMP.
- MSIX builds; `W99` log `STATUS=DONE`.
